title: Secretary Rubio’s Call with China’s Director of the Office of the CCP Central Foreign Affairs Commission and Foreign Minister Wang
author: Office of the Spokesperson
summary:
Office of the Spokesperson

Secretary Rubio’s Call with China’s Director of the Office of the CCP Central Foreign Affairs Commission and Foreign Minister Wang

Readout

July 2, 2026

The below is attributable to Spokesperson Tommy Pigott:

Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with China’s Director of the Office of the CCP Central Foreign Affairs Commission and Foreign Minister Wang Yi. Secretary Rubio discussed the importance of building a constructive relationship of strategic stability based on fairness and reciprocity, as outlined by President Trump.
